conditions.Binding: Identify actual subject/intended predicate, governing interpretation, applicable policy and source/current-state coordinates; names/equal bytes alone confer neither identity, standing nor applicability.
conditions.Support: Account for conditions and material dependencies that can change the determination. Inspect affected seams until governing obligations are covered or far-side independence is evidenced. Task boundaries, partial listings and no observed failure do not prove independence. Domain-owned completeness/sufficiency may not be silently narrowed.
conditions.Preservation: Establish material input/output/cross-boundary relations under declared compatibility or translation, applying Foundations Preservation obligations to the claimed step/composition. Retain identity, meaning, lifecycle, producer/evidence coordinates, constraints, authority and effects. Lawful differences require the admitted instance relation; neither universal equality nor invented translation decides compatibility.
conditions.Authority: Establish actual operation/decision grant for selected effect. Keep owners of meaning, evidence, operation and disposition distinct; code, source reference or satisfied judgment supplies no grant. Preserve required independence.
conditions.Currentness: Acquire observations/concurrency/uncertain effects under Workspace and context, and apply Change impact and evidence retention to existing evidence. Supported changed dependencies reopen affected determination; unsupported currentness stays unresolved. Supported unchanged premises permit reuse without rechecking fixed graphs or every unchanged relation on every event.
conditions.Result: Apply core result/conjunction to actual predicates; retain failures, absent coverage, basis/scope diagnoses, original outcomes, performance and effects. Unknown applicability is not non-applicability; other uncertainty cannot erase supported failure.

obligations: Each consumer binds these conditions to its own decision and domain exceptions using existing dependency/authority evidence; do not create a second generic-rule owner. Exceptions must be named in owning policy; application cannot invent one.

Design admission binds its transition and complete enclosing relation; frame activation binds evaluation, subject, basis and actor. Both apply the six shared conditions while retaining different domain predicates. Reuse a supported condition through its validity route; a boundary crossing alone neither repeats proof nor permits omission of a changed dependency.
